messages:
maria: FYI I opened a docs PR to add an on-prem KMS deprecation + migration guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Need reviewers from infra/docs. TL;DR: customers using the legacy KMS shim need steps to migrate to pkcs11-backed HSM or cloud-KMS fallback.

doc-bot: PR #4321 created by maria — labeled docs, onprem, kms. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai/

aj: nice. can you add a compatibility matrix for installer versions (1.8 → 1.11)? some enterprise tenants still on 1.8.

maria: yes — planning to add a table that maps installer version -> supported KMS adapters and recommended action. will include airgap notes and offline fallback steps.

ryan: also add a note about the migration window and stateful rollback steps. i hit a customer issue when they rolled back without clearing kv-cache. recommend calling out `kv-cache flush` and the potential for stale tokens.

sophie: i can help with the SDK snippet updates. we should show python + go examples for token-signing and key rotation. sample python:

```python
from redwood_sdk import KMSClient
client = KMSClient(kms_provider='pkcs11', module_path='/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so')
client.rotate_key('redwood-main-key')
```

sophie: go snippet:

```go
kc := kms.NewClient(kms.WithProvider("pkcs11"), kms.WithModule("/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so"))
kc.RotateKey(ctx, "redwood-main-key")
```

aj: small nit: use `kms_provider: \"hsm\"` in the YAML installer examples to match the CLI flag and existing docs.

maria: good catch. will update. also fixing a broken anchor link under the "network ports" section — noticed `#networking-requirements` was 404 in prod, so i'll patch the heading + add redirects.

infra-bot: deploy preview finished — status: success :white_check_mark: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai/knb/onprem/kms-deprecation

sophie: can someone assign a docs reviewer? @ryan @aj

ryan: i can review tomorrow morning.

aj: assigning to me for SDK snippets + tests. i'll run the snippet linter and the example unit tests.

maria: checklist i'm tracking in the PR body:
- [x] initial draft
- [ ] compatibility table
- [ ] SDK snippets (py/go)
- [ ] airgap install commands + tarball examples
- [ ] link fixes + anchors
- [ ] final review

maria: question — do we want to add a short migration script in examples/ to copy certs + restart services? saves operators a step but needs ops signoff.

ryan: yes, but keep it opt-in. ops teams should understand it's a helper, not an automated migration. add clear warnings and a `--dry-run` flag.

aj: i'll add a lightweight bash at examples/migration.sh with comments and a `--dry-run`. also will include `systemd` restart snippet:

```bash
sudo systemctl stop redwood-agent
sudo rsync -av certs/ /etc/redwood/certs/
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl start redwood-agent
```

maria: perfect. also plan to add an airgapped section showing how to import the pkcs11 module and where to place module files when customers cannot reach the internet.

sophie: one more: update the SDK changelog blurb so downstream teams know about the parameter name changes. i'll draft that.

maria: aiming to merge by EOD Friday. ping if you hit anything blocking. :pray:

doc-bot: Reminder — add an 'eval' prompt set if you want quality regression alerts after migration (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals).
